children: Atyant Capital Management offloaded a 2.73% stake in Seshasayee Paper and Boards, a manufacturer of printing and writing paper, through open-market transactions on October 27.

Shares of Seshasayee Paper came under pressure following the stake sale, falling 10% to Rs 192.94 and closing at their lowest level since July 2022. The stock has remained under sustained selling pressure over the past month, despite intermittent buying.

Atyant Capital India Fund I, managed by Atyant Capital Management, sold 17.23 lakh equity shares of Seshasayee Paper and Boards, representing 2.73% of its paid-up equity capital, for Rs 35.5 crore. The shares were sold at an average price of Rs 206.24 apiece.
The sale was part of the 5.36% stake held by Atyant Capital in the company as of September 2026.

On the other side of the transaction, promoter entity Time Square Investments acquired an additional 5.7 lakh shares, equivalent to 0.9% of the company's paid-up equity capital, for Rs 12.25 crore at Rs 214.99 per share.
WisdomTree fund sells 0.58% stake in MSTC

Meanwhile, WisdomTree Emerging Markets High Dividend Fund, an exchange-traded fund issued by WisdomTree Trust, sold 4.13 lakh shares of state-owned MSTC, representing 0.58% of its paid-up equity capital, for Rs 23.22 crore.
The shares were sold at Rs 561.32 apiece.

MSTC shares fell 4.4% amid above-average trading volumes, closing at Rs 556.05, their lowest closing level since June 10. The stock has remained under pressure over the past month, despite intermittent buying.
Investor Ramesh Saraogi buys additional 0.7% stake in Advit Jewels
Shares of jewellery company Advit Jewels gained 3.2% to Rs 348.80, potentially supported by investor Ramesh Saraogi's acquisition of additional shares.
High-net-worth individual Ramesh Sawalram Saraogi acquired an additional 3.25 lakh shares in Advit Jewels, equivalent to 0.7% of its paid-up equity capital, for Rs 10.81 crore.
The shares were purchased at Rs 332.72 apiece.
Jaipur-based Advit Jewels manufactures traditional and contemporary handcrafted fine jewellery. Saraogi already held a 1.53% stake, equivalent to 7 lakh shares, in the company as of September 2026.

title: Atyant Capital sells 2.73% stake in Seshasayee Paper; MSTC, Advit Jewels see bulk deals
